clue.text: Mention a new name

indicators.note: new tells us the letters of the words before it are made into something new, a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to bring up a fresh name in conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' looks like it describes the name, but it is the anagram signal: MENTION plus A, rearranged, gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To nominate someone is to put their name forward as a candidate, a sense of the verb to name.

clue.text: Tough element making little money in the USA

definitions.meaning: a hard, durable metallic chemical element
the US five-cent coin, a small sum

explanation.surface: A hard metal turns out to be worth very little across the Atlantic.
explanation.definitionFit: The metal Ni is hard and resistant to corrosion; in America a five-cent coin carries the metal's name.

clue.text: Miniature record

definitions.meaning: a written note of proceedings, as of a committee meeting

explanation.surface: A tiny model is put on file.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means tiny; as a noun it is the official written record of a meeting.

clue.text: Provided a home for a good man in straitened circumstances

indicators.note: in tells us one piece is placed inside the other, the saint sitting within the hardship

parts.note: being in need means living in straitened circumstances, short of money
ST, short for saint, is the crossword's usual good man

explanation.surface: Someone took in a virtuous man who had fallen on hard times.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds that nested made a home, so the verb means housed or gave shelter, here used generally.

clue.text: Act the liar in dramatic fashion

indicators.note: to fashion something is to shape or make it, so the letters of the preceding words are reshaped

explanation.surface: A liar puts on a show, performing with great flair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in dramatic fashion' reads as one adverbial phrase, but 'dramatic' is the definition and 'fashion' the anagram signal on ACT THE LIAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatrical behaviour is showy and exaggerated, as if on a stage; both words describe the stage.

clue.text: Quietly managed church dance

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction meaning quietly
ran, as in ran a business, means managed
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A quiet church manages to hold a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: To caper or move with high springy steps is a kind of dancing, so the verb is a synonym of dance.

clue.text: Communist anger over small weight available to send on

parts.note: a red is a colloquial name for a Communist
ire is a literary word for anger
CT is the abbreviation for carat, a small weight used for gems

explanation.surface: A Communist's rage about a tiny weight that is available to be sent onward.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'over' simply places RED above IRE and CT; it is a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: To forward mail to a new address is to route it again elsewhere, which is what sending on means.

clue.text: The piece of lamb being 2down, one prepared stuffing

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held: 'The piece of lamb being 2down, one prepared stuffing' (8). NOISETTE; ONE anagrammed gives NOE but no reading of 'being 2down' (MINUTE) supplies ISETT, so the wordplay cannot be completed from the clue as printed.
annotationWithheld.clue: The piece of lamb being 2down, one prepared stuffing

clue.text: The end of the day — flat time

parts.note: even means level or flat, as an even surface
tide is an old word for time, as in Yuletide

explanation.surface: At day's end everything is flat and calm.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetic word for evening, the close of daylight hours.

clue.text: Case of wine returned by college-head

indicators.note: the head of the word college is its first letter
returned tells us the word for the wine is written backwards

parts.note: retsina is a Greek white wine flavoured with resin

explanation.surface: A college principal sends back a box of wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'college-head' looks like one title, a principal, but it means the first letter of 'college'.
explanation.definitionFit: A canister is a container, such as a metal box for tea, so a case in the sense of a holder.

clue.text: Publicity-a bad thing for counsel

parts.note: an ad is an advertisement, a piece of publicity
a vice is a wicked habit, a bad thing

explanation.surface: Advertising is a bad thing, according to the counsel offered.
explanation.definitionFit: Counsel as a noun is guidance or a recommendation given to someone.

clue.text: Admission about tea-maker's appeal

indicators.note: about tells us one word goes round the other, the entry surrounding the remade tea

parts.note: entry is admission, as to a building

indicators.note: the tea's maker remakes it, so the letters of tea are re-formed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone getting into a place makes a request about the tea-maker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maker's' turns TEA into EAT, which 'about' places inside ENTRY.
explanation.definitionFit: An entreaty is an earnest plea, a heartfelt request, so an appeal.

clue.text: Stop a man painting back lounge

indicators.note: back says the abbreviation for the painter is turned round

parts.note: RA, a Royal Academician, is a member of the Royal Academy of Arts, a painter
to lounge is to rest or laze

explanation.surface: Someone halts an artist who is lazing around at the back.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrest something is to halt or check it, as in arresting decline.

clue.text: Great hotel totally transformed

indicators.note: transformed says the letters of the preceding words are changed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A grand hotel has been completely made over.
explanation.definitionFit: Altogether means wholly or completely, a synonym of entirely.

clue.text: Finding out Ted is a clod, may well be put out

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of the following words are put out of their order

explanation.surface: Learning that Ted is a lout may leave you upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put out' reads as annoyed, but here it means knocked out of joint, as a bone.
explanation.definitionFit: A dislocated shoulder has been put out of its socket, displaced from its proper position.

clue.text: Carol's about top for elocution

indicators.note: about tells us the word for carol goes around the word for top

parts.note: to carol is to sing joyfully; the 's here is just is
a peak is a top, as of a mountain

explanation.surface: A singer called Carol is concerned with first-rate speech training.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carol' looks like a woman's name but is the verb to sing.
explanation.definitionFit: Elocution is the art of clear, expressive talking, the skill of delivering words aloud.

clue.text: Fights when on trial within the Civil Service

indicators.note: within puts the following pieces inside the abbreviation for the service

parts.note: CS is the abbreviation for the Civil Service
a test is a trial

explanation.surface: Battles break out when things are tested inside the government's administration.
explanation.definitionFit: Contests are struggles or competitions, bouts of fighting.

clue.text: The French set about a bridge game

indicators.note: set about means placed around, so the French article goes round the other pieces

parts.note: le is a French word for the
to bridge a river is to cross it

explanation.surface: French people organise a game of bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bridge game' suggests cards, but 'bridge' is the verb, CROSS; 'set about' wraps LE round ACROSS.
explanation.definitionFit: A field sport played with netted sticks, originally from North America.

clue.text: Given support at getting into silver and gold, it increases

parts.note: a prop is a support

indicators.note: getting into puts the little word inside the pair of metal symbols

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Backed by riches in silver and gold, something grows.
explanation.definitionFit: A propagator is a heated box used to raise seedlings, so a device that multiplies plants.

clue.text: Fed-up with the aim to get cover

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: Someone sick of their purpose seeks shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fed-up' reads as annoyed, but it is FED turned up.
explanation.definitionFit: To cover a position is to guard or protect it, as in military defence.

clue.text: The sponsor may take no part

indicators.note: may take suggests the letters can take on a new form, a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A backer may decline to get involved.
explanation.definitionFit: A patron supports an artist or cause financially, a backer.

clue.text: Look round about a quarter undisturbed

indicators.note: round says the word for look goes around the other pieces

parts.note: to see is to look
re is Latin for about, concerning
N, north, is one of the four quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: Gazing around a district, everything seems calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Serene means calm and peaceful, untroubled.

clue.text: A rigid back

parts.note: stern means strict and unbending, rigid

explanation.surface: A stiff back.
explanation.definitionFit: Astern means towards the rear of a ship, behind, so at the back.

clue.text: 21 down will accept a number to sing

indicators.note: will accept means the first word takes the other letters inside it

parts.note: the answer to 21 down, meaning calm
D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: A calm person will take on a number to perform.
explanation.definitionFit: To serenade is to perform music for someone, often under a window at night.

clue.text: To maintain some ancient remains is thought proper

indicators.note: some tells us only part of the following words is taken, a run of letters within them

explanation.surface: Keeping a few ancient relics is considered right.
explanation.definitionFit: To insist is to assert firmly, as in maintaining that something is true.

clue.text: Supplier of wood for sabot manufacturers?

definitions.text: Supplier of wood for sabot manufacturers?

parts.words: Supplier of wood for sabot manufacturers?
parts.note: pictures a tree grown for clog timber, while the real object is a foot-shaped former kept inside footwear

explanation.surface: Asks which tree provides timber for clog-makers.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden form placed in footwear to keep its shape, jokingly read as a tree on which clogs grow.

clue.text: Following the talk the man's making cuts

indicators.note: following places the second piece after the first

parts.note: to gas is to chatter idly
he's is a contraction of he is, the man is

explanation.surface: After the chat, someone starts slicing.
explanation.definitionFit: Gashes are deep cuts or wounds.

clue.text: She's wisdom personified

parts.note: a girl's name that is also a word for good judgment

explanation.surface: A woman embodying sound judgment.
explanation.definitionFit: A female name that is also the virtue of careful judgment.
